profile.headline: Full Stack Developer @ Intelligent Retinal Imaging Systems | .NET Framework, Blazor, C#
profile.summary:
Intelligent Retinal Imaging Systems (IRIS) benefits from contributions in full stack development, leveraging expertise in .NET Framework, Blazor, and C#. With 1.5+ years at IRIS, the focus has been on creating innovative healthcare solutions, enhancing operational efficiency, and supporting patient care initiatives through technology.  

Over four years of experience as an Integration Consultant with DevScripts Solutions and EmergencHealth has honed skills in system integration and healthcare technology. Committed to developing impactful software solutions, the mission remains to advance the intersection of healthcare and technology, fostering seamless interoperability and improved outcomes.

positions.title: Integration Analyst
positions.description:
•	Implemented and maintained interface projects between hospital clients and third-party vendors from start to finish.
•	Work extensively with the Mirth Connect application to move patient data from a Microsoft SQL database into HL7 messages for downstream vendors
•	Acted as a primary resource for other interface analysts by troubleshooting JavaScript and Linux shell issues.
•	For my projects as well as those on my team, I worked on improving client relationships by anticipating technical needs and addressing them
•	Studied and gained a familiarity with hospital software and day-to-day work flow, learning both Healthland's Centriq and Evident's Thrive UX software.
•	Kept a running understanding of HL7 standards and employed them in interface installation.
•	Worked extensively with ASTM communicating lab instruments.
